title: Goldfish wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='fishBody' cx='40%' cy='40%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFD84A'/>
      <stop offset='70%' stop-color='#FF9E1B'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#E8671A'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='hatGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#5AD1FF'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#2A8DF0'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M18 58 C6 44, 4 66, 12 74 C6 78, 10 86, 22 76 Z' fill='#FF7A2E'/>
  <path d='M20 60 C13 52, 12 68, 17 72' fill='none' stroke='#FFC24A' stroke-width='2'/>

  <!-- top fins -->
  <path d='M40 34 C44 24, 54 24, 52 34 Z' fill='#FF8A2E'/>
  <path d='M54 33 C60 23, 68 26, 64 37 Z' fill='#FF8A2E'/>

  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='57' rx='34' ry='23' fill='url(#fishBody)'/>
  <!-- belly highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='65' rx='24' ry='11' fill='#FFE58A' opacity='0.85'/>
  <!-- scale hints -->
  <path d='M36 55 q5 -6 10 0' fill='none' stroke='#FFC24A' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M48 53 q5 -6 10 0' fill='none' stroke='#FFC24A' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M44 64 q5 -6 10 0' fill='none' stroke='#FFB83A' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- bottom fin -->
  <path d='M48 78 C56 88, 68 84, 60 76 Z' fill='#FF8A2E'/>

  <!-- side fin -->
  <path d='M52 62 C58 68, 66 64, 60 56 Z' fill='#FFB83A'/>

  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='70' cy='49' r='8.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='71' cy='49' r='4.6' fill='#23244D'/>
  <circle cx='72.6' cy='47.2' r='1.6' fill='#FFFFFF'/>

  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M80 60 q5 3 1 6' fill='none' stroke='#D4531A' stroke-width='2.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- party hat -->
  <path d='M52 34 L68 30 L64 4 Z' fill='url(#hatGrad)'/>
  <path d='M57 31 L63 28 L61 9 Z' fill='#8FE8FF' opacity='0.55'/>
  <!-- hat stripes -->
  <path d='M57 24 L67 21' stroke='#FFE24A' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M55 16 L66 13' stroke='#FF6BB5' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- pom pom -->
  <circle cx='64' cy='4' r='5' fill='#FF6BB5'/>
  <circle cx='62.5' cy='3' r='1.8' fill='#FFB8DC'/>
  <!-- hat band -->
  <path d='M51.5 35 L68.5 31 Q67 38 65 36 Z' fill='#FFE24A'/>
</svg>
